verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms DBOS serves an llms.txt at docs.dbos.dev/llms.txt that follows the llmstxt.org standard and links to its documentation sections. Doc pages are also served at .md URLs (e.g., ai/streaming.md, reference/cli.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: visibility into the full llms.txt contents (the probe excerpt is truncated, and there's no evidence of an llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.
